title: Crepioca with chicken and tomato
steps: Dice the chicken, salt it and fry it in the oil for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Whisk the eggs with the tapioca starch and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Pour into a hot non-stick pan and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes, then flip.
Spread with cream cheese, add the chicken and diced tomato, sprinkle with oregano and fold over.
